reviews.title: Eh ok
reviews.text: Sometimes this drawing/sketch pad is awesome and works really well and other times it sucks. When I am drawing the pencil does not stay the same thickness. It gets really annoying. I will have to move my hands in a weird position just for the thickness to stay consistent. Then sometimes when I try to just move the picture a random line goes across my drawing that I have to undo after I am done turning. With the thickness issue and the issue when turning my work causes me to hit the undo button a lot which gets really annoying. But when it isn’t doing that I am able to draw great pictures.

reviews.title: Not bad, but needs more
reviews.text: No SVG support for design and export? I enjoy using this app, and it’s got a nice interface, but this lack of ability to scale my designs is a dealbreaker for my needs. Also, I would love to have snapping options to close objects correctly. This would be helpful all around, but especially in perspective mode where I struggle to connect lines or even draw short ones in the “distance”.
